# Feature: V6 Echo / Delay engine resolve

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #344 -->

## Intent
Engine queues for Echo and delayed formula resolution in Startphase (§8 steps 3–4). Catalyst stays until resolve, then discards. No Default-Flip; no full recipe matrix — playtest recipe hooks only.

## Preconditions
- Match with `v6Formula` / `meta.v6FormulaEnabled`
- Formula activation with Echo or Verzögerung timing (playtest recipes / hooks)
- Owner reaches own Startphase with pending queue entries

## Happy Path
- [ ] Echo: primary resolves immediately; echo amount queued; catalyst stays until Startphase resolve then discard
- [ ] Verzögerung: primary deferred to next own Startphase with delay bonus; then discard catalyst
- [ ] Startphase order: Echo queue then Delay queue (before Fessel tick)
- [ ] Echo/Delay resolve grants no additional Fetz
- [ ] Unit tests in `src/game/`; `npm run checks` green

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Empty queues → Startphase unchanged aside from existing Fessel/Arena
- [ ] Catalyst already removed before resolve → still apply queued primary; skip discard
- [ ] Slice-1 105 catalog unchanged (no Echo/Delay in locked matrix)

## Out of scope
- Full Echo UI (#345)
- Full 60×K matrix / Slice-1 catalyst expansion
- Play-Default cutover; Konstrukte; Default-Flip

## Security Coverage
- F-03: typed engine state / actions; UI does not invent resolve
- P-04: local-only match state

## Regression
- [ ] Existing V6 TEK / Fessel / Affinity tests still pass
- [ ] V5 Echo/Delay meta path unchanged

## Assumptions
- V5 semantics ported: Echo repeats 1 pt of primary; Delay defers primary +2
- Playtest hooks: 1 Echo + 1 Delay TEK recipe outside locked 105 catalog
